target_beneficiary: Women aged 21 to 65 years residing in Maharashtra
financial_benefit: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 annually) direct DBT transfer to Aadhaar linked bank account
short_description: Financial assistance scheme to promote economic independence, nutrition, and health for underprivileged women in Maharashtra.

criteria_points: Applicant must be a permanent female resident of Maharashtra.
Age must be between 21 and 65 years.
Combined family annual income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh (exempt if holding Yellow or Orange Ration Card).
Family members must not be regular government employees or income tax payees.
Bank account must be Aadhaar seeded and DBT enabled.

required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / Ration Card / Voter ID (valid proof of 15 years residence)
Income Certificate (Income up to ₹2.5 Lakh) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card
Undertaking (Hamipatra) regarding income tax and government employment status
application_mode: Online & Nari Shakti Doot App / Anganwadi / Setu Kendra

target_beneficiary: Landholding small and marginal farmers in Maharashtra
financial_benefit: ₹6,000 per year (in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000) supplementary to PM-KISAN, totaling ₹12,000/year
short_description: Maharashtra government top-up financial grant to PM-Kisan registered farmer families to support input purchase and livelihood stability.

criteria_points: Farmer family must be an active beneficiary of PM-KISAN in Maharashtra.
Must possess cultivable land record (7/12 extract) registered in their name.
e-KYC and Aadhaar seeding with bank account are mandatory.
Institutional landholders and serving/retired govt officers are excluded.

application_mode: Online via PM-KISAN / MahaDBT Agriculture Portal

name_en: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
name_mr: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना
name_hi: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना
target_beneficiary: All Ration Card holder families and citizens of Maharashtra
financial_benefit: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,356 medical and surgical procedures
short_description: Universal health protection scheme providing completely cashless quality medical care through network hospitals across Maharashtra.

criteria_points: Universal coverage extended to all valid Ration Card holders (Yellow, Orange, White) and Maharashtra residents.
Special coverage for farmers in suicide-prone districts.
Must have valid ID proof and Ayushman Bharat / MJPJAY beneficiary card.

required_documents: Valid Ration Card (Yellow, Orange, or White)
Tahsildar Income Certificate (for specific non-ration card categories)
application_mode: Cashless at Empanelled Network Hospitals through Arogyamitra Desk

department_name: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
target_beneficiary: Destitute elderly, widows, orphans, disabled persons, and terminal patients
financial_benefit: ₹1,500 per month for single beneficiary, ₹2,100 per month for families with two or more beneficiaries
short_description: Monthly financial pension to destitute individuals unable to earn a livelihood due to age, disability, widowhood, or illness.

criteria_points: Age 65 years and above (or 40%+ disabled persons, widows, divorced women of any age).
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹50,000 (relaxed to ₹1,00,000 for families with severe disability).
Must be a resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
No earning child supporting the applicant.

required_documents: Age Proof / Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate
Disability Certificate from Civil Surgeon (if applicable)
application_mode: Offline at Tahsildar Office / Setu Kendra or Online via Aaple Sarkar

name_en: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
name_mr: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना (ईबीसी)
name_hi: राजर्षि छत्रपति शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क छात्रवृत्ति योजना (ईबीसी)
target_beneficiary: Economically Backward Class (EBC) students in Higher/Technical/Professional courses
financial_benefit: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and exam fees for Open/General category students
short_description: Fee concession scheme enabling meritorious students from economically weaker sections to pursue higher and technical education.

criteria_points: Candidate must be a Domicile of Maharashtra.
Enrolled in CAP-approved technical/professional/higher education course.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 from all sources.
Minimum 50% marks in previous examination.
Maximum 2 children from the same family eligible.

required_documents: Income Certificate from Tahsildar (up to ₹8 Lakhs)

name_en: Post Matric Scholarship for SC / ST / VJNT / OBC / SBC
department_name: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
target_beneficiary: SC, ST, VJNT, OBC, SBC students pursuing post-matriculation studies
financial_benefit: 100% tuition/exam fee waiver + monthly maintenance allowance based on course tier
short_description: Comprehensive educational financial assistance providing full fee waiver and maintenance stipend to backward category students.

criteria_points: Applicant must belong to recognized SC/ST/VJNT/OBC/SBC category in Maharashtra.
For SC/ST: Income limit up to ₹2,50,000. For OBC/VJNT/SBC: Income limit up to ₹1,50,000 for 100% scholarship (up to ₹8,00,000 for freeship).
Must be admitted through government or CAP centralized admission process.
Must have valid Caste and Caste Validity Certificate.

required_documents: College Admission Fee Receipt & Allotment Letter

name_en: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
name_mr: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख वसतिगृह निर्वाह भत्ता योजना
name_hi: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख छात्रावास निर्वाह भत्ता योजना
target_beneficiary: Children of registered marginal farmers and registered construction workers pursuing professional degrees
financial_benefit: ₹30,000/year (for MMRDA/Pune/Nagpur/Nashik/Aurangabad cities) or ₹20,000/year (other areas) for hostel sustenance
short_description: Hostel allowance scheme for farmer and low-income students studying in government/aided/unaided professional colleges.

criteria_points: Student admitted to approved professional courses (Engineering, Medical, Pharmacy, Agri, Architecture, etc.).
Parent must be an Alpabhudharak (Marginal Farmer with land up to 5 acres) or Registered Laborer.
Family income up to ₹8,00,000 for marginal farmers.
Not availing government hostel facility.

required_documents: Alpabhudharak Certificate (Small Farmer) / 7/12 Extract or BOCW Registration
College Bonafide and CAP Allotment Letter

name_en: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Pond on Demand) & Krishi Yantrikikaran
name_mr: मागेल त्याला शेततळे व कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना
name_hi: मागेल त्याला खेत-तालाब एवं कृषि यंत्रीकरण योजना
target_beneficiary: Individual farmers wanting to construct farm ponds or purchase modern farm machinery
financial_benefit: Direct subsidy of up to ₹75,000 for Farm Pond construction with plastic lining; up to 50% subsidy on tractors and farm implements
short_description: Water security and farm mechanization scheme to protect crops against drought and improve agricultural productivity.

criteria_points: Farmer must possess minimum 0.60 hectare (1.5 acres) cultivable land.
Must not have taken prior subsidy for farm pond on the same plot.
Site must be technically viable for water storage.
Priority to small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, and drought-hit talukas.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Caste Certificate (if applicable)
Self-Declaration of land ownership and no previous grant
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT Farmer Schemes Portal

target_beneficiary: Girl children born in poor families (Yellow and Orange Ration Card holders)
financial_benefit: Financial grant of total ₹1,01,000 distributed at progressive stages (Birth ₹5k, Std 1 ₹6k, Std 6 ₹7k, Std 11 ₹8k, Age 18 ₹75k)
short_description: Stage-wise financial incentive to promote girl child education, prevent female foeticide, and eliminate child marriage in Maharashtra.

criteria_points: Girl child born on or after 1 April 2023 in Maharashtra.
Family holding Yellow or Orange Ration card.
Parents must undergo family planning surgery after 1 or 2 children.
Applicable for maximum two girl children per family.

required_documents: Family Planning Operation Certificate (for second stage grants)
School Bonafide Certificate at enrollment stages
application_mode: Offline at Anganwadi Center / CDPO Office or Online through MahaDBT

department_name: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
target_beneficiary: Senior citizens aged 65 years and above in Maharashtra
short_description: Old age pension support for destitute senior citizens in rural and urban Maharashtra.

criteria_points: Citizen must be 65 years of age or older.
Category A (BPL List) or Category B (Family income below ₹21,000/year).
Residing in Maharashtra continuously for at least 15 years.

required_documents: Age Proof (School Certificate/Electoral Card/Medical Board Certificate)
Income Certificate (Tahsildar issued <= ₹21,000) or BPL Certificate
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook (DBT Linked)
application_mode: Offline at Tahsildar / Setu Kendra or Online via Aaple Sarkar

name_en: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana (Youth Internship Scheme)
department_name: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department
target_beneficiary: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years with minimum 12th pass / Diploma / Degree
financial_benefit: Monthly stipend of ₹6,000 (12th Pass), ₹8,000 (ITI / Diploma), or ₹10,000 (Graduates / Postgraduates) for 6 months on-the-job training
short_description: Skill enhancement internship providing hands-on workplace training and stipend in government and private industries.

criteria_points: Candidate must be a resident of Maharashtra.
Age between 18 and 35 years.
Minimum educational qualification: 12th Standard, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, or Post Graduation.
Candidate must be registered on Mahaswayam portal.

name_mr: भारतरत्न डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर स्वाधार योजना
department_name: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Neo-Buddhist students who did not get government hostel admission
financial_benefit: Annual allowance up to ₹60,000 (Division HQ), ₹51,000 (District HQ), or ₹43,000 (Taluka HQ) for lodging, boarding and books
short_description: Financial stipend for SC students pursuing professional & higher education outside their home district who could not secure government hostel seats.

criteria_points: Belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Neo-Buddhist community.
Family income less than ₹2,50,000 per annum.
Admitted in recognized higher/technical college at a distance > 5 km from hometown.
Did not receive admission in Social Justice Govt Hostel.
Minimum 50% marks in previous examination (40% for Divyang).

required_documents: Caste Certificate and Caste Validity Certificate
Hostel Rejection / Non-Availability Certificate or Self-Declaration
application_mode: Offline to Assistant Commissioner Social Welfare / MahaDBT
